peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Lower relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Lower relative price than most peers: 10.5% below its local comparables; 7 of 34 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (87.5): 5.7 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 38 of 44 similar developments (the same as 1). Context, not scored: resales in 79.2% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $2,050,000 ($1,685 psf, 1,216 sq ft; 5 resales, Mar 2024–Feb 2026); 7 comparable developments within 5 km: median $2,003 psf (range $1,822–2,159); 15.9% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $387,000 less. 3-bedroom: median $2,830,000 ($1,592 psf, 1,711–1,883 sq ft; 8 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 5 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,680 psf (range $1,490–2,148); 5.2% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $156,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Keppel MRT about 3,160 m, Cantonment MRT about 3,180 m; closer than 2 of 44 similar developments. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 0 within 2 km; nearest Zhangde Primary School about 4,790 m; more than 0 of 44 similar developments (the same as 28). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 2 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 300 m), more than 4 of 44 similar developments (the same as 7); nearest hawker centre Blk 6 Tanjong Pagar Plaza Market And Food Centre about 3,580 m; nearest park Sisters' Island Marine Park about 1,330 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: No other condo development sold new homes within 2 km. Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 9 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 0 new sales and 64 resales (64 purchases); new sales were 0% of these purchases. Subsales (0) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 64 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 1 of 44 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 64 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 63 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (+1.6%). Planning-area private resales +6.6%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
